events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Assurances

options.text: The price is high. But if [character] is willing to pay...
We don't need the [rival]. We don't need any of them.

events.text: The missive from [character] begins, "We accept your terms of Peace Player." Your enthusiasm, however, falls considerably with the next line. "There is but one additional term we must insist upon. If this peace is to last, we must truly have trust in [rival]. If you want to make your intentions clear, send [character] to reside in [city] as a mark of our strong relations."

events.author: Jeri Roys
conditions: Not Player At Least 3 Cities Founded
events.name: Faltering Ambition

options.text: If the people will not choose to leave for new frontiers, I will have to give them no other choice.
Anyone may have a foolish idea, but only a fool remains committed to it.

events.text: At first, it seemed the dream of [rival] lands as far as the eye could see would be as inevitable as it would be glorious. But time has passed, and the world has closed in. Doubts have encrusted that dream as barnacles encrust a hull.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Faltering Ambition

options.text: If his tactical brilliance lives up to the reputation, nothing else matters.
Wait, [character], the one that was drunkenly swearing at the baggage caravan just now? No, enough, [rival] will make do with the generals it has.

events.text: To Four Generals felt an easy enough task. The pickings have been, however, slim. The number of [rival] nobility fit to command a full division has been... humblingly small. But [character] has been trying to convince you that his protegee [character] might be precisely the kind of person you have been looking for to fill out the command ranks. [character] sure has been using the phrase 'rough around the edges' a lot, though.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Faltering Ambition

options.text: Glory demands risk and sacrifice.
There has to be another way.
A wise king is one capable of changing his mind.

events.text: [rival] needs more people in order to grow and thrive. Or so you once concluded, what now feels an age ago. Now your generals are offering exactly that, served up on a silver (if slightly bloodstained) platter. The warbands of the [tribe] lie in disarray following a bitter internal feud, while [rival] forces stand poised for a campaign of capture and conquest.

events.author: Jeri Roys
conditions: Not Player Chose Ambition Within 15 Turns
events.name: Faltering Ambition

options.text: If we want to advance [rival] into a glorious new age, something has to change.
Anyone may have a foolish idea, but only a fool remains committed to it.

events.text: Time changes one's perspective. One day, you look out at the world with a vision, and the next... well, it's not actually the next, it's so many you have long ago lost count. Actually very little has changed, and that vision feels no closer. Change will be Unpopular, but it is time to admit that the current course is floundering.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Faltering Ambition

options.text: This will cause upheaval and no end of administrative challenges, but it might be worth it.
[character] has convinced me... that we must rethink exactly what it is [rival] needs.

events.text: Reform of the military, and building its numbers, has long been a part of your proclamations and court discussions. Even your most enthusiastic advocates, however, are forced to admit that progress towards a force built of Volunteers has been slow. [character] offers a promising, if radical, lifeline to these faltering plans. If land could be redistributed in a less piecemeal fashion, fewer laborers might be required for the same harvest, and more able-bodied soldiers might find their way into the military.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Politeness Comes First

options.text: It is time to send [character] a discreet message.
Enough. If the Tribe want nothing to do with us, so be it.

events.text: Peace Tribe, it seems, is not quite so easy as an open heart and good intentions. The Tribe have over time proven both stubborn and, in your opinion, wildly ill-mannered. All the same, you may have a new approach. The [tribe] are known to take certain marks of dishonor incredibly seriously, and, in a stroke of luck, you have just the evidence to paint [character] in a very unfavorable light...

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: What would I do without you, [character]

options.text: Why, what a wonderful idea!
Do you know what, the more I think about it, [rival] really needs to put its priorities elsewhere.

events.text: [character] gesticulates enthusiastically as he continues, "I cannot agree more that the cities of [rival] need to be expanded! Did you know I have been considering investing in just such a new Theater 1 in the heart of [city]? With your help, I would love to put to bed some other, tedious [family] matters and put more time into the project."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Work Ethic

options.text: Whatever it takes to build our future, we shall do it.
There has to be another way.
We must rethink what it is [rival] needs.

events.text: The list of unfinished, let alone unstarted, projects in [rival] only seems to grow longer by the day. Many of your advisors are now pushing you toward drastic actions to "get [rival] back on track."
